fieldValues.title: 4. Effort: size and complexity
fieldValues.thinking_reached: size: small, medium, large, xl, and size:XS (no space). complexity: simple, medium, complex, and also low, small, high. Present in srs-rust in full and as subsets elsewhere. clerk board size sets small, medium, large or xl.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Six complexity labels for three levels (simple, low, small; medium; complex, high).
- 'small' appears in both size and complexity.
- size:XS follows a different spelling from the other sizes.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Is complexity used for anything the derived priority or queue reads?
fieldValues.next_action: Collapse to one size scale and one complexity scale (quick win, proposed).
